overview: GuardAlign proposes a training-free defense framework for LVLMs that integrates OT-enhanced safety detection to identify and mask unsafe image patches via optimal transport distance, and cross-modal attentive calibration to persistently reinforce safety prefix signals during decoding, achieving significant unsafe response rate reduction while preserving model utility.

modules.name: CLIP Feature Extraction Module
modules.description: Implements image and text encoding using CLIP model, extracting global and patch-level visual features as well as textual embeddings for unsafe prompt categories, serving as the foundation for all subsequent OT-based alignment computations.

modules.name: Image Patch Decomposition Module
modules.description: Decomposes input images into fine-grained patches with corresponding feature representations, supporting configurable patch counts and enabling patch-level semantic analysis for malicious region identification.

modules.name: Unsafe Prompt Category Definition Module
modules.description: Defines and expands a set of unsafe prompt categories covering pornographic, violent, political, harmful, illegal, and privacy domains, generating textual variants per category to serve as semantic anchors for unsafe content detection.

modules.name: Entropy-Based Weight Computation Module
modules.description: Computes importance weights for image patches and textual variants based on entropy with respect to average prompt embeddings, assigning higher weights to low-entropy (more confident) patches to prioritize discriminative features for OT alignment.

modules.name: Optimal Transport Distance Module
modules.description: Implements the Sinkhorn-Knopp algorithm with entropic regularization to efficiently compute OT distances between image patch distributions and unsafe prompt distributions, quantifying alignment between visual content and harmful semantics.

modules.name: Unsafe Patch Detection and Masking Module
modules.description: Aggregates OT transport contributions across all unsafe prompt categories per patch, applies threshold-based classification to identify unsafe regions, and constructs sanitized images by masking detected malicious patches while preserving benign areas.

modules.name: Safety Prefix Construction Module
modules.description: Constructs safety-aware prefixes appended to user prompts to activate intrinsic safety mechanisms of LLM backbones, including prefix token management and integration with the LVLM input sequence.

modules.name: Cross-Modal Attention Calibration Module
modules.description: Implements attention score modification in middle layers of the LVLM by amplifying attention toward prefix tokens from instruction tokens using a masked Hadamard product, ensuring safety signals persist throughout generation and preventing prefix decay.

modules.name: GuardAlign Inference Pipeline Module
modules.description: Orchestrates the complete inference workflow combining OT-enhanced detection with cross-modal attention calibration: sanitizing input images, prepending safety prefixes, feeding into the LVLM with calibrated attention, and autoregressively generating safe responses.

modules.name: Safety Evaluation Module
modules.description: Computes core safety metrics including Unsafe Response Rate (USR) and Attack Success Rate (ASR) using a safety-optimized LLM judge and target-string matching, supporting evaluation across SPA-VL, MM-SafetyBench, FigStep, and adversarial benchmarks.

modules.name: Utility Evaluation Module
modules.description: Evaluates model utility preservation on general multimodal benchmarks including MME, MMBench, ScienceQA, TextVQA, and VQAv2, along with GPT-4-Turbo-based helpfulness scoring and win-tie pairwise comparisons on SPA-VL Help.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework Module
modules.description: Provides controlled variable experiment infrastructure to independently enable/disable OT-enhanced detection and cross-modal attention calibration, compare OT distance versus cosine similarity baseline, and quantify individual component contributions to safety and utility.

modules.name: Sensitivity and Robustness Analysis Module
modules.description: Conducts hyperparameter sensitivity analysis on detection threshold, calibration strength, and patch count, evaluates robustness across different CLIP backbones (RN50 to SigLIP), and tests under adaptive adversaries targeting patch-level detection and decoding-phase vulnerabilities.

modules.name: Efficiency Analysis Module
modules.description: Measures and compares inference time and computational overhead against baseline and competing defense methods (ECSO, ETA), profiling the runtime cost of OT computation, patch masking, and attention calibration components.

modules.name: Scalability and Compatibility Evaluation Module
modules.description: Evaluates GuardAlign on larger LVLMs (InternVL2.5-38B/78B) for scalability, tests compatibility with post-hoc safety fine-tuning for additive improvements, and assesses black-box applicability using OT-enhanced detection alone on closed-source models (Gemini, GPT-4V).

modules.name: Configuration and Result Reporting Module
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations including benchmark selection, model backbones, and hyperparameters; aggregates results across safety/utility benchmarks; generates formatted LaTeX tables and visualizations including patch feature distribution plots, attention decay curves, and masking examples.
